description_zh: 查询已创建的负载均衡实例
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-load-balancers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server-id i-2zebcbq000000 --address-ip-version ipv4 --load-balancer-status active --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa0000 --load-balancer-name test --server-intranet-address 10.XX.XX.102 --address-type intranet --internet-charge-type paybytraffic --vpc-id vpc-bp1aevy8sof0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp12mw1f8k30000 --network-type vpc --address 192.168.XX.XX --master-zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --slave-zone-id cn-hangzhou-d --tags tagKey_:_Key1_,_tagValue_:_Value1 --pay-type PayOnDemand --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4p0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLoadBalancers

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401682.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401682.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backend server that is added to the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 添加的后端服务器ID
parameters.name: server_id

parameters.help_en: The IP version. Set the value to **ipv4** or **ipv6**
parameters.help_zh: IP版本，可以设置为**ipv4**或者**ipv6**
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

- **inactive**: The instance is stopped. Listeners of an instance in this state do not forward traffic.

- **active**: The instance is running. This is the default state of an instance after it is created.

- **locked**: The instance is locked. An instance enters the locked state after it expires. This state lasts for seven days. You cannot perform operations on the instance. The instance does not forward traffic, but its IP address and other configurations are retained
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态。取值：

- **inactive**: 实例已停止，此状态的实例监听不会再转发流量。

- **active**: 实例运行中，实例创建后，默认状态为**active**。

- **locked**: 实例已锁定。当负载均衡实例到期后，但到期时间未超过7天时，负载均衡实例进入锁定状态。此种状态下，您不能对负载均衡实例进行任何操作，并且实例不再会进行流量转发，但会保留实例的IP和其它配置
parameters.name: load_balancer_status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CLB instance.

You can specify up to 10 IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例ID。

支持多值查询，最多可输入10个ID，以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the CLB instance.

The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

You can specify up to 10 names. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例名称。

长度为1~80个英文或中文字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

支持多值查询，最多可输入10个名称，以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en:
The internal IP address of the added backend server.

You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
添加的后端服务器的内网地址。

支持多值查询，以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: server_intranet_address

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the CLB instance. Valid values:

- **internet**: An Internet-facing CLB instance. The system assigns a public IP address to the instance. The instance can forward requests from the Internet.

- **intranet**: An internal-facing CLB instance. The system assigns a private IP address to the instance. The instance can forward requests only within internal networks
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的网络类型。取值：

* **internet**：创建公网负载均衡实例后，系统会分配一个公网IP地址，可以转发公网请求。

* **intranet**：创建内网负载均衡实例后，系统会分配一个内网IP地址，仅可转发内网请求
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the Internet-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

- **paybybandwidth**: pay-by-bandwidth.

- **paybytraffic**: pay-by-data-transfer.

<props="china">

If **PayType** is set to **PrePay**, only pay-by-bandwidth is supported. If **InstanceChargeType** is set to **PayByCLCU**, only pay-by-data-transfer is supported.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
公网计费方式。取值：
- **paybybandwidth**：按带宽计费。

- **paybytraffic**：按流量计费。

<props="china">当**PayType**参数的值为**PrePay**时，只支持按带宽计费。当**InstanceChargeType**参数的值为**PayByCLCU**时，只支持按流量计费。</props>
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the CLB instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例所属的VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the CLB instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例所属的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the internal-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

- **vpc**: a VPC.

- **classic**: a classic network
parameters.help_zh:
私网实例的网络类型。取值：

- **vpc**：专有网络类型。 

- **classic**：经典网络类型
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: The service address of the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的服务地址
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary zone of the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例的主可用区ID
parameters.name: master_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary zone of the CLB instance.

The multi-zone feature is not available for Alibaba Finance Cloud users
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的备可用区ID。

目前对金融云用户暂时不支持多可用区功能
parameters.name: slave_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The tags that are added to the CLB instance. The value is a JSON dictionary that consists of tag keys and tag values.

You can add up to 10 tags in each request
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例绑定的标签列表，其结构是一个JSON dictionary，包含标签键和标签值。

一次请求中，绑定的标签列表中最多支持10个标签
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the CLB instance. Valid values:

- **PayOnDemand**: pay-as-you-go.

<props="china">

- **PrePay**: subscription.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例付费模式。取值：

* **PayOnDemand**：按量付费。

<props="china">- **PrePay**：包年包月。</props>
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: **1** to **100**.

> If you set **PageSize**, you must also set **PageNumber**
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

取值范围：**1**~**100**。

> 如果设置了**PageSize**，则需要同时设置**PageNumber**
parameters.name: page_size

element_fields.help_en:
The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to **20**. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The value of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to **20**. The tag value can be an empty string.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。N的取值范围：**1~20**。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag
